overview: Force Stasis is a master-level light side technique classified under Telekinesis. Suspends a target in a telekinetic stasis field, immobilizing limbs and freezing motion without inflicting direct harm. Master-level practitioners can hold multiple assailants at once, as seen when senior Jedi subdued rampaging foes during Temple disturbances.
history:
Force scholars trace Force Stasis across eras recorded in holocrons, Jedi Archives data-tapes, and Sith tombs on Korriban and Dromund Kaas. Practitioners documented in KOTOR · KOTOR II · Clone Wars · The Old Republic established the modern understanding of how this ability manifests in combat, meditation, and ritual.

During the Old Republic and Sith Empire conflicts, masters drilled Force Stasis into initiates as part of the standard curriculum for telekinesis specialisation. Surviving battle logs from the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War show the technique adapted to blaster-era warfare, starfighter engagements, and close-quarters lightsaber duels.

In the sequel era, surviving texts and oral traditions kept knowledge of Force Stasis alive even as the Jedi Temple fell and the Sith assumed new forms. Each generation reinterpreted the power through its own doctrine while the underlying Force mechanism — channelled midi-chlorian symbiosis and focused will — remained constant.

The Jedi teach that this ability must serve life, consent, and the greater good — never domination or fear.
significance:
Force Stasis exemplifies how telekinesis abilities shape Force doctrine on the light side. At master mastery, users balance raw potential against discipline, emotional control, and the moral weight of their choices.

Historians note that armies and orders rose or fell partly on how widely and wisely this technique was taught. A single master of Force Stasis could turn a skirmish, break a siege, or unravel an enemy's will before blades crossed.

For students today — in academies, hidden enclaves, or alone with ancient texts — Force Stasis remains a benchmark of telekinesis proficiency across the Star Wars saga.
